infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BeVital uses your location to find physiotherapists near you and to share your home-visit address. Your physiotherapist's location is shared with you only while they are on the way.

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BeVital lets you attach photos or documents to your health profile.
